scope: Synthetic SEO/admin acceptance only; not complete storefront or production recovery
preconditions: Explicit approval for exact schema and synthetic Auth fixtures
Auth no-delivery policy approved and applied independently
Recheck empty public schema, zero Auth users, migrations, schedules and outbound hooks
Owner-authorized transaction and rollback strategy; refuse replacing existing objects

stages.name: Synthetic catalogue prerequisites
stages.note: Three fixture products and two categories. Preserve restrictive checks, RLS and service-role SELECT-only. The old proposal says five migrations; this plan supersedes that count with six.

stages.name: Synthetic staff authorization prerequisites
security: Revoke all privileges from PUBLIC, anon, authenticated and service_role before granting only service_role SELECT
No anonymous/authenticated policies, no public writes, no trigger/webhook
Fixture owner inserts only; no project-wide default privilege changes
No settings.edit, categories.edit, staff.manage or roles.manage permissions
stages.note: Tables satisfy current admin session/access reads, not the entire staff management UI.

stages.name: Six pinned SEO migrations
stages.note: Use decoupled base, never combine with historical synchronous base. Preserve initial disabled AI/budget controls; never start workers.

stages.name: Synthetic preconfirmed Auth users after separate Auth acceptance approval
stages.method: Reviewed Admin createUser with email_confirm true, independent random passwords; no invitations, signup or recovery messages
security: Verify staging endpoint again before each write
Do not use user_metadata for authorization
Owner matches the existing ADMIN_EMAIL exactly
No production users, identities, backups or password hashes

stages.name: Manual fixture-only SEO initialization
stages.note: If required, invoke reviewed sync_seo_document only for allowlisted fixture IDs inside provisioning transaction; do not run worker, queue consumer, cron or AI. Verify disabled budgets and empty request authorizations.

acceptance: Verify exact created object inventory and migration hashes
Verify all 13 SEO and five prerequisite tables have RLS and explicit grants
Anonymous and authenticated roles cannot read staff/private SEO tables or invoke private RPCs
Owner/editor/viewer/revoked boundaries enforced from real staging sessions only after Auth acceptance approval
Editor can save, viewer cannot mutate, revoked staff cannot receive admin session; publication and rollback stay owner-only
All feature flags remain false; mutation activation is a separate approval, not part of provisioning
Validate zero provider calls, no schedules, no deliveries, no external endpoints
Do not claim full storefront compatibility: prices/orders/shipping/commerce tables are deliberately absent
rollback: On precommit failure roll back the transaction and stop
After commit retain evidence; do not drop objects or delete users without separate approval
Do not automatically retry a partly applied migration; compare exact inventory first
limitations: Proposal is not SQL and has not been executed
Prior local six-migration tests used synthetic catalogue tables; this additional staff/Auth plan is not yet an executed rehearsal
Full public storefront may show unavailable/empty data until broader synthetic schema is separately reviewed
